summary: Preview-only validation of the belt-and-braces raised-date rendering fix in VariationOrders.jsx (VariationRow, line ~292). Seeded 5 VOs via POST /api/variation-orders/variation-orders as darrenhustle300, then asserted the rendered text of [data-testid=vo-row-raised-<id>] on /app/variation-orders. 4/5 test cases PASSED as-specified; case (e) mismatch is caused by BACKEND behaviour (empty variationDate coerced to today's ISO server-side), NOT a card render bug — the card in case (e) still renders correctly formatted DD/MM/YYYY with NO raw ISO leak. Bundle-level confirmation also PASSED: /static/js/bundle.js on Preview contains the new `vo-row-raised-` data-testid marker, the `raisedText` memo, the ISO regex fallback, and `formatUKDate`. Zero occurrences of raw YYYY-MM-DD on any card in any of the 5 probes — the P1a defensive fix is proven to hold.

minor.issue: When variationDate is submitted as empty string '', the backend silently coerces it to today's ISO date (2026-09-07) instead of storing empty/null. This affects test case (e) but has no impact on the card ISO-leak bug being validated. Consider preserving null/empty so the em-dash fallback path can be exercised in the UI.

issues: React hydration warning: <a> descendant inside <a> on Dashboard ProjectCard (LinkWithRef nesting cc-project-* -> cc-project-photos-*). Not related to this fix but observed in console during navigation. Pre-existing.

action_items: None for the P1a fix — belt-and-braces rendering is proven correct. Safe to re-deploy pending user approval.
OPTIONAL follow-up (not blocking): backend POST/PATCH variation-orders should NOT rewrite empty variationDate to today's date, so the em-dash fallback becomes reachable in real data.
critical_code_review_comments: VariationRow raisedText memo (lines 296-306) correctly layers three defences: formatUKDate → inline ISO regex → em-dash. Logic is sound; regex ^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) covers both date-only and full ISO datetime.
Empty-string case never reaches the '—' branch because backend coerces to today's date; this is a backend concern, not a card concern.
File is 786 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold, consider extracting VariationWizard into its own module in a future refactor.

Bundle confirmed to contain the new logic (vo-row-raised- testid + raisedText memo + ISO regex + formatUKDate). Cleanup completed.

rca of the issue.user_report: Production cards showed 'Raised 2026-09-07' (raw ISO) instead of 'Raised 07/09/2026'.
rca of the issue.fix_applied: VariationRow now computes raisedText via a three-tier fallback: (1) formatUKDate → returns DD/MM/YYYY only if it matches the pattern, (2) inline regex ^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) extracts and re-orders any raw ISO substring, (3) em-dash for truly empty values. A new data-testid='vo-row-raised-<id>' allows automated assertion.
rca of the issue.validation: 5 seeded variations (ISO date, ISO date x3, ISO datetime, empty) all rendered with DD/MM/YYYY on the card — no YYYY-MM-DD substring anywhere. Bundle contains all new markers. Fix is proven belt-and-braces safe.
